CreateAPrimaryInstance.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string of up to 64 characters
CreateAPrimaryInstance.billing: Billing-related parameters. [Refer to structure and values](/doc/RDS/s/9jwvz0wd3#billing)
CreateAPrimaryInstance.purchaseCount: Number of RDS instances to create in batch, up to 10; default 1
CreateAPrimaryInstance.instanceName: 1) User-defined instance name; 2) Lowercase letters and digits allowed; 3) Length limited to 1-64; 4) Default naming rule: {engine} + {engineVersion}
CreateAPrimaryInstance.engine: Database engine: MySQL, SQLServer, PostgreSQL. [Refer to details](/doc/RDS/s/9jwvz0wd3#%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B)
CreateAPrimaryInstance.category: Instance series: Singleton (single-node basic), Standard (dual-node high availability). Default Standard. [Refer to details](/doc/RDS/s/9jwvz0wd3#%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E8%B4%AD%E4%B9%B0%E7%B3%BB%E5%88%97)
CreateAPrimaryInstance.memoryCapacity: Package memory size in GB. [Refer to values](/doc/RDS/s/9jwvz0wd3#%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%8F%AF%E9%80%89%E5%A5%97%E9%A4%90)
CreateAPrimaryInstance.volumeCapacity: Package disk size in GB, incremented in steps of 5G. [Refer to range](/doc/RDS/s/9jwvz0wd3#%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%8F%AF%E9%80%89%E5%A5%97%E9%A4%90)
CreateAPrimaryInstance.diskIoType: Disk type: normal\_io: local SSD disk cloud\_high: high-performance cloud disk cloud\_nor: general-purpose SSD cloud\_enha: enhanced SSD
CreateAPrimaryInstance.zoneNames: Specifies zone information; empty by default, auto-selected by the system. The zone list can be queried via the [Query Availability Zone List](/doc/RDS/s/zka65zqz2) API. The zoneName naming convention is lowercase "country-region-zone sequence", e.g., Beijing zone A is "cn-bj-a".
CreateAPrimaryInstance.bcmGroupName: Empty by default, representing the BCM instance group name
CreateAPrimaryInstance.vpcId: VPC; if not provided, belongs to the default VPC. Available VPCs can be queried via the [Query VPC List](/doc/VPC/s/wjwvyub23) API
CreateAPrimaryInstance.isDirectPay: Whether to pay directly; default false. Change orders set to direct pay are charged immediately without going through the payment flow
CreateAPrimaryInstance.subnets: The subnetId for each availability zone within the VPC; subnetId must be specified if not the default VPC. When creating a cluster edition, if the primary and standby zones share the same subnet, only one item needs to be passed in this array. The subnet list can be queried via the [Query Subnet List](/doc/RDS/s/Wka66184u) API.
CreateAPrimaryInstance.tags: Tag information bound to the instance
CreateAPrimaryInstance.bgwGroupId: If bgwGroupExclusive is true and a dedicated cluster ID is specified during instance creation, the BLB is assigned to the specified dedicated cluster; otherwise the default applies
CreateAPrimaryInstance.bgwGroupExclusive: Load balancer cluster attribute; true indicates a dedicated cluster, false indicates a shared cluster
CreateAPrimaryInstance.characterSetName: Specifies the instance character set; options are "utf8mb4", "latin1", "gbk", "utf8", default "utf8" (currently only supported for MySQL primary instances)
CreateAPrimaryInstance.autoRenewTime: Auto-renewal duration (no more than 3 when the unit is year, no more than 9 when the unit is month)
CreateAPrimaryInstance.lowerCaseTableNames: Whether table names are case-sensitive. Default 0, meaning case-sensitive; 1 means case-insensitive
CreateAPrimaryInstance.ovip: The ovip of the BLB access entry for the RDS instance. If this parameter is passed with a non-empty value, the BLB is requested using this value as the BLB ovip; otherwise the BLB is assigned a random IP
CreateAPrimaryInstance.entryPort: The port of the BLB access entry for the RDS instance. If this parameter is passed with a non-empty value, the BLB is requested using this value as the BLB listener port; otherwise defaults to 3306. Port range: 1024-65535
CreateAPrimaryInstance.replicationType: Data replication method. Asynchronous replication: async; semi-synchronous replication: semi\_sync
CreateAPrimaryInstance.resourceGroupId: Resource group ID. For example: RESG-bKMxbExtnoG
CreateAPrimaryInstance.initialDataReference.instanceId: The InstanceId of the data source
CreateAPrimaryInstance.initialDataReference.referenceType: Only two values allowed: datetime, snapshot
CreateAPrimaryInstance.initialDataReference.datetime: Target time point for restoring databases/tables to the new instance. Required when referenceType is datetime; the target time for initial data import, in standard time format, China +8 time zone
CreateAPrimaryInstance.initialDataReference.snapshotId: Required when referenceType is snapshot; the target backup set for initial data import, taking the backup set ID
CreateAPrimaryInstance.data: Database/table information for restoring to the new instance
CreateAPrimaryInstance.data.restoreMode: Indicates the restore mode; supports both database and table
CreateAPrimaryInstance.data.dbName: Name of the database to restore
CreateAPrimaryInstance.data.newDbname: Indicates the database name after restoration
CreateAPrimaryInstance.data.tables: Indicates the database name after restoration
CreateAPrimaryInstance.leaderInstanceId: MySQL primary role ID. The MySQL major version of the passed instance must match the MySQL major version in the current creation parameters. When this parameter is specified, the MySQL minor version of the new instance will match the MySQL minor version of the specified instance
CreateAPrimaryInstance.resourceType: Instance type; supports exclusive/shared, default exclusive. exclusive indicates dedicated type, shared indicates general-purpose type
